title: Lambs on the Mountain

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Welcome up, friend! You've come at the best time of year: the lambs are being born!

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Each new mother and her lamb need a pen of their own for a few days. Would you help me settle them? Two in each pen: a ewe and her lamb.

steps.speaker: silas
steps.prompt: Put two sheep in each pen: a mother and her lamb.
steps.hint: Find a pen with an empty dip, and put a sheep there.

older.prompt: Some ewes have twins! Three in each pen this time: a mother and two lambs. Six pens.

feedback.full: That pen has its family. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four snug pens, eight sheep. Listen to those little bleats!

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: New life on the mountain. Every spring it surprises me, and every spring I give thanks for it.

journal_line: I helped Mr. Silas settle the ewes and new lambs into pens.

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: Six pens of three: eighteen sheep, and so many twins! What a spring.
